description: This file defines a Duration type in Go that implements various interfaces for arithmetic, comparison, conversion, and method dispatch, specifically for handling durations in the context of CEL (Common Expression Language). It includes methods for adding, subtracting, comparing, and converting durations, as well as retrieving duration components like hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: A struct that embeds time.Duration and implements ref.Val for CEL duration values, supporting arithmetic, comparison, conversion, and method dispatch.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another Duration or Timestamp to this Duration.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares this Duration with another, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts the Duration to native Go types or protobuf representations.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the Duration to specified CEL types like string, int, or Duration.

methods.name: IsZeroValue
methods.description: Returns true if the Duration is zero.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Dispatches method calls based on function name and overload.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another Duration from this Duration.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the value, which is Duration.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the underlying value, a time.Duration.
